events.headline: FAMILY MOURN INDIAN SAILOR KILLED IN US STRIKE ON OIL TANKER
events.detail: The wife and family of an Indian sailor killed in a US strike on a tanker off Oman this week have gathered in mourning.

events.headline: US-IRAN CEASEFIRE? NOT FOR INDIAN SAILORS BEING KILLED IN HORMUZ
events.detail: The United States military has struck three vessels in the Strait of Hormuz this week, killing three Indian sailors.
